0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Celtics visit the Pistons, and Boston will be without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The Celtics lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Boston a 50% chance of winning.
